app.title: Lithobox Creator
info.panels: Side lithophanes: {w} × {h} mm (front/back) and {d} × {h} mm (left/right), {t} mm thick
warn.postTooThin: Posts are too thin for these slots: make them at least {min} mm.
warn.baseTooThin: The base is too thin for the panel groove and lamp seat.
warn.lidTooThin: The lid is too thin for its grooves.
warn.magnetNoFit: The magnets don't fit into the corner plugs. Use smaller magnets or posts of at least {post} mm.
warn.bed: The box is {size} mm wide, larger than your {bed} mm print bed.
shape.box.name: Box
shape.box.param.panelWidth.help: Outer width of the side lithophanes including their border.
shape.box.param.panelThickness.help: Thickness of the lithophane border (the thickest part).
shape.polygon.param.topPanel: Lithophane in the lid (one more picture)
shape.box.param.slotClearance.help: Room in front of and behind each lithophane in its slot, both sides together. Default 0.7 mm: 0.6 mm plus 0.05 mm per side. Raise it if the lithophanes are hard to slide in.
shape.box.group.clearances.hint: Play between parts that fit into each other. The defaults are 0.05 mm per side looser than an exact fit. Raise a value if parts are too tight, lower it if they are loose. "Per side" applies on each side, "total" is shared between both sides.
shape.box.param.slotWidthClearance.help: Room along the lithophane's edges in its slot (left and right, and round a lid picture or a shaped picture such as the heart), both sides together. Default 0.7 mm. Raise it if a print comes out a little wide.
shape.box.param.powerTrayClearance.help: Play on each side between the base and the battery tray it sits in. Default 0.35 mm.
shape.box.param.discClearance.help: Extra room round the steel disc in its recess. Default 0.25 mm.
shape.box.param.holderClearance.help: Play on each side between the lamp holder's plug and its socket in the foot. Default 0.2 mm.
shape.box.param.hoodClearance.help: Play on each side between the hood's walls and the base's ledge they sit on. Default 0.35 mm.
shape.box.param.frameClearance.help: Play on each side between the back insert and the frame's room. Default 0.25 mm.
shape.box.param.spiderClearance.help: Play between the spider's outer ring and the shade's inside wall when it is pushed up to the rim. Default 0.35 mm.
shape.box.param.slotEngage.help: How far the lithophane edges reach into the corner posts.
shape.box.param.postSize.help: Width of the corner posts that hold the lithophanes in their grooves. Thicker posts are sturdier, and the box gets wider with them.
shape.box.param.faceInset.help: Distance between the outside of the box and the lithophane surface.
shape.box.param.lampDiameter.help: Diameter of the recess the lamp sits in. The default 64 mm fits most round USB puck lights up to 60 mm.
shape.box.param.lampSeatDepth.help: How deep the round seat for the puck light is sunk into the base. Deeper keeps the light in place; 0 leaves the base flat.
shape.box.param.baseGroove.help: How deep the lithophanes stand in the groove in the base. Deeper holds them more firmly but hides a little more of the picture's bottom edge.
shape.box.param.cableHoleWidth.help: Width of the hole the cable or plug goes through, for your own cable.
shape.box.param.cableHoleLength.help: Length of the slot the cable goes through.
shape.box.param.cableHoleOffset.help: Distance from the lamp centre to the middle of the slot.
shape.box.param.cableChannel.help: A channel under the base for the lamp's cable, so the lamp stands flat with the cable plugged in.
shape.box.param.topLedge.help: Width of the ledge the lid's lithophane rests on, round its opening. Wider supports it better but covers more of the picture's edge.
shape.box.param.lidGroove.help: How deep the tops of the lithophanes reach into the groove in the lid. Deeper holds them more firmly but hides a little more of the picture's top edge.
shape.box.param.plugDepth.help: Tapered plugs under the lid that slide into the corner posts. 0 turns them off.
shape.box.param.plugTaper.help: The lid's plug narrows by this angle towards its end, so it slides in easily and wedges firm. 0° is straight.
shape.box.param.plugClearance.help: Play on each side between the lid's plugs or pegs and their sockets. Default 0.2 mm. Raise it if the lid is hard to put on, lower it if it wobbles.
shape.box.param.magnetClearance.help: Extra room round each magnet in its pocket. 0.2 mm gives a press fit on most printers; raise it if the magnets do not go in.
shape.box.param.bedSize.help: Your printer's bed size (its shorter side, if it isn't square). The app warns when a part is larger than that.
info.power: Power base: room for a battery or power bank up to {t} mm thick
warn.noRoom: The corner posts are too small for this lid closure. Make them thicker.
warn.cableOutside: The cable hole is too long for this box: it would reach the back lithophane's groove. Make it shorter or the box bigger.
warn.bankTooBig: The power bank doesn't fit between the corner pillars. At most {w} × {l} mm fits.
shape.box.param.cableMode.help: Where the power cable leaves your lamp. 'Side' makes a long, wide slot that reaches past the lamp's edge, for lamps that are charged from the side.
shape.box.param.cableMode.side: Out of the side of the lamp
shape.box.param.lidJoint.help: How the lid stays on. Corner plugs centre the lid, magnets give it a firm click.
shape.box.param.latchLength.help: How far the snap latches reach. Longer latches hold more firmly but take more force to open.
shape.box.param.latchThickness.help: Thickness of the snap latches. Thicker ones are stiffer and snap harder; thinner ones bend more easily but can break.
shape.box.param.latchHook.help: How far the hook catches. Deeper holds tighter but is harder to open.
shape.box.param.pegSize.help: Size of the square pegs that line up the lid (or the battery tray) with the box. Bigger pegs hold more firmly.
shape.box.param.powerBase.help: An open tray under the box, like the original's battery base: the power bank lies inside, the box stands on top and closes it.
shape.box.param.bankClearance.help: Extra room added to the power bank's length and width in its pocket, both sides together. Default 1.1 mm. Raise it if the power bank sits too tight, lower it if it rattles.
warn.lampTooBig: The lamp seat is larger than the inside of the box. At most {max} mm fits.
warn.holderTooBig: The lamp holder does not fit inside the curve: use a larger radius, a wider picture or a smaller lamp.
shape.box.param.steelDisc.help: A shallow recess in the middle of the lamp seat for the steel disc that comes with magnetic-base bulbs. Glue the disc in and the bulb snaps onto it.
shape.box.param.discDiameter.help: Diameter of the steel disc as it comes with the bulb. Its play is set under Clearances.
shape.box.param.discDepth.help: Thickness of the steel disc. The recess is this deep, so the disc sits flush.
shape.box.param.switchType.help: A cut-out in the front for a switch between power bank and lamp. The wall is thinned to 2 mm around it so snap-in switches fit.
shape.box.param.switchWidth.help: Width of the cut-out for a rocker switch in the battery tray's front wall. Switch makers list it as the panel cut-out size.
shape.box.param.slideWidth.help: Width of the cut-out for a slide switch in the battery tray's front wall. Measure the part of the switch that goes through the wall.
shape.box.param.slideScrewPitch.help: Distance between the two mounting screws. 0 leaves out the screw holes.
shape.box.param.buttonDiameter.help: Diameter of the round hole for a push button in the battery tray's front wall.
shape.box.param.switchOffset.help: Where the switch sits along the front wall, measured from the middle. Negative values move it to the other side.
shape.box.param.ledWindow.help: A slot in the front so you can see the power bank's charge indicator.
shape.box.param.ledWindowWidth.help: Width of the window in the battery tray's front wall that lets the power bank's charge lights show through.
shape.box.param.ledWindowOffset.help: Where the window sits along the front wall, measured from the middle, so you can line it up with the power bank's lights.
warn.switchNoFit: The switch doesn't fit into the front of the power base. Make it smaller or the inside taller.
warn.switchBank: The power bank leaves no room behind the switch. Use a bank of at most {l} mm length.
warn.switchLed: The switch and the LED window overlap. Move one of them.
warn.ledNoFit: The LED window doesn't fit into the front of the power base.
shape.box.param.baseText: Text on the front of the base
shape.box.param.baseText.help: A name or date on the front of the base. With a power base it goes on the power base.
shape.box.param.topText.help: Goes on the front edge of the lid next to the top lithophane, or across the whole lid when there is no top lithophane (room for several lines).
shape.box.param.textSecondColor: Print raised text in a second colour
shape.box.param.textSecondColor.help: Exports the letters as their own part on filament 2, for printers with several filaments (AMS / multi-material).
warn.textShrunkBase: The front text is too big for the space and was made smaller.
warn.textShrunkTop: The top text is too big for the space and was made smaller.
warn.textPower: The front text overlaps the switch or the LED window. Move them aside or make the text smaller.
profile.title: Slicer profile (optional)
profile.hint: Pick any 3MF project you saved in OrcaSlicer or Bambu Studio. Your printer and settings are taken from it, so the download opens as a ready project with one plate per part. It stays in this browser and is never uploaded.
profile.none: No profile: the 3MF opens as plain parts on one plate (use Arrange in the slicer).
profile.errNotProject: That file has no slicer settings. Use a project saved with File > Save Project in OrcaSlicer or Bambu Studio.
ui.noWebgl: Your browser didn't allow 3D graphics (WebGL), often because hardware acceleration is turned off or the graphics driver is blocked. You can still change every setting and download the files. To get the preview: turn on hardware acceleration in the browser settings and restart it, or try another browser.
ui.noWebgl.firefox.1: Settings > General > Performance: untick "Use recommended performance settings" and tick "Use hardware acceleration when available".
ui.noWebgl.firefox.2: Restart Firefox completely and reload this page.
ui.noWebgl.firefox.3: Still nothing: type about:config in the address bar, search for webgl.force-enabled, set it to true and restart Firefox.
ui.noWebgl.chrome.1: Settings > System: turn on "Use graphics acceleration when available".
ui.noWebgl.chrome.3: Still nothing: open chrome://flags, enable "Override software rendering list" and relaunch.
ui.noWebgl.edge.1: Settings > System and performance: turn on "Use graphics acceleration when available".
ui.noWebgl.edge.3: Still nothing: open edge://flags, enable "Override software rendering list" and restart.
ui.noWebgl.safari.1: Update macOS / iOS: Safari has 3D from version 15 on.
ui.noWebgl.safari.2: Mac: Safari > Settings > Advanced, tick "Show features for web developers", then Develop > Feature Flags and make sure WebGL 2.0 is on.
ui.noWebgl.other.1: Turn on hardware or graphics acceleration in your browser's settings and restart it.
ui.noWebgl.other.2: Or open this page in a current Firefox, Chrome, Edge or Safari.
shape.box.param.discKeepClear: Keep the cable hole clear of the disc
shape.box.param.discKeepClear.help: Moves the cable hole outwards so 2 mm stay between it and the disc. Turn it off to place the hole yourself; it may then overlap the disc.
shape.box.preset.mini: Mini box, 7 cm (50 mm lithophanes, 40 mm tea light)
shape.box.preset.xl: XL box, 21 cm (190 mm lithophanes, fits a 256 mm bed)
shape.box.param.powerHeight.help: Free height for the power bank. 22 mm fits banks up to about 20 mm thick.
shape.box.param.powerJoint.help: How the box holds on the power base: magnets in the corners, small pegs, or it just stands in the rim.
shape.box.param.powerJoint.none: None, it stands in the rim
shape.box.param.chargeSlot.help: A slot in the back wall, so you can charge the power bank without lifting the box.
shape.box.param.bankPocket: Guide rails for one power bank
shape.box.param.bankPocket.help: Rails that hold a power bank of a given size in place, open to the back so it slides in.
pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.hint: Add your photos, then pick one for each side. Each side keeps its own crop and tone. Photos stay on your computer (saved in this browser for your next visit), nothing is uploaded.
pictures.loadError: This file could not be opened as a picture.
pictures.editHint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, double-click a slider to reset it. Dark areas become thick, light areas thin.
warn.finsMerged: Support fins break off cleanly only from the 3MF for Bambu Studio / Orca. In STL and Plain 3MF they are joined to the lithophane and the slicer fuses them to it.
shape.box.param.lithoMinThickness.help: Thickness of the brightest areas. The darkest areas and the margin use the full lithophane thickness.
shape.box.param.lithoCurve.help: How brightness becomes thickness. "By light let through" picks the thickness so the light shining through matches the photo's brightness, which gives mid-tones and highlights more steps. "Linear" takes thickness straight from brightness, as many older generators do.
shape.box.param.lithoQuality.help: Grid spacing of the relief: how many height points the picture gets per millimetre. Turn on "Print view" to see the relief at this detail. On a 0.4 mm nozzle Normal is enough for most pictures; Fine only helps with very small text or fine lines, and only if the photo has enough pixels.
shape.box.param.lithoSupports.help: Thin breakaway fins on the margin hold the lithophane upright while printing, so it needs no brim.
shape.box.param.lithoMargin.help: Frame of full thickness around the picture; it sits in the slots.
shape.box.param.lithoColour.help: The photo's colours as thin layers of cyan, magenta and yellow behind the white relief. Needs a printer with four filaments (white, cyan, magenta, yellow). Colour pictures print lying flat, picture side down, at 0.1 mm layer height. Flat pictures only.
shape.box.param.colourLayers.help: At most this many 0.1 mm colour layers on top of each other. More layers give stronger colours; the picture gets a little darker overall.
shape.box.param.filamentCyan.help: Your filament's colour. The colour separation uses it, so the mix matches what is loaded in the printer.
shape.box.param.filamentMagenta.help: Your filament's colour. The colour separation uses it, so the mix matches what is loaded in the printer.
shape.box.param.filamentYellow.help: Your filament's colour. The colour separation uses it, so the mix matches what is loaded in the printer.
pictures.samples: No photo at hand? Try sample pictures
info.lithoSize: {n} lithophanes: about {tris} million triangles, the download will be about {mb} MB
pictures.dropHere: Drop photos here, or click to choose (several at once)
pictures.libraryHint: Drag a photo onto a side, or use "Choose". Drag one side's picture onto another side to swap them.
pictures.dragToSwap: Drag onto another side to swap
pictures.removeAllConfirm: Remove all photos from this browser? The sides lose their pictures too.
project.saveHint: Save the design and its photos as one .lithobox file, as a backup or to send to someone
project.openHint: Open a .lithobox file: its design and photos replace the current ones
project.replaceConfirm: Opening this project replaces your current design and photos. Continue?
project.errInvalid: This is not a Lithobox project file, or it is damaged.
project.errNewer: This project was saved by a newer version of Lithobox Creator. Reload the page to get the newest version, then try again.
project.errShape: This project uses a shape this version does not know.
project.photosMissing: Photos that could not be read and were left out: {n}
shape.panel.name: Flat picture
shape.panel.param.panelWidth.help: Outer width of the lithophane including its frame.
shape.panel.param.lightDepth.help: Room between the picture and the back wall. More depth spreads the light more evenly over the picture.
shape.panel.param.wallThickness.help: Side walls, back wall and top of the hood. Thicker walls let less light through.
shape.panel.param.lighting.stand: Open stand with a puck light holder behind the picture
shape.panel.param.lampDistance.help: Gap between the back of the picture and the front of the lamp holder. More distance spreads the light more evenly but makes the stand deeper.
shape.panel.param.holderDepth.help: How deep the puck light sits in the holder's cup. About half the lamp's height holds it firmly.
status.printView: Print view: relief grid {res} mm, {tris} triangles
shape.box.param.lithoSupportSize.help: The flat feet under the fins work like a brim and keep the picture from tipping over while it prints. Larger feet hold tall pictures better; smaller ones save a little material.
shape.cylinder.name: Cylinder lamp
shape.cylinder.param.cylDiameter.help: Outside diameter of the lithophane. The picture runs all the way round, so its width is the circumference: about 3.1 times the diameter.
shape.cylinder.param.topRing.help: A ring that sits on the upper edge. It keeps the cylinder round and covers the edge; light still comes out of the open middle.
shape.cylinder.param.baseRim.help: How far the base and the top ring reach out past the cylinder. Wider rims stand more firmly.
info.cylinder: Lithophane: Ø {d} × {h} mm, {t} mm thick, the picture runs {w} mm round
shape.arc.name: Arc
shape.arc.param.arcWidth.help: Length of the lithophane measured along its curve, margin included. Seen from the front it looks a little narrower.
shape.arc.param.arcRadius.help: Radius of the curve's outside. Smaller bends more and stands more firmly; larger is flatter. The info box shows the angle it spans.
shape.arc.param.lighting.stand: Open stand with a puck light holder behind the picture
shape.arc.param.lampDistance.help: Gap between the back of the picture and the front of the lamp holder. More distance spreads the light more evenly but makes the stand deeper.
shape.arc.param.holderDepth.help: How deep the puck light sits in the holder's cup. About half the lamp's height holds it firmly.
shape.arc.param.wallThickness.help: Side walls, back wall and top of the hood. Thicker walls let less light through.
shape.arc.param.baseRim.help: How far the base or the feet reach past the lithophane on each side.
info.arc: Lithophane: {w} × {h} mm along the curve, {t} mm thick, radius {r} mm ({a}°)
warn.arcTooBent: The arc would bend more than a half circle. For this width the radius must be at least {min} mm.
shape.polygon.name: Polygon lamp
shape.polygon.param.panelWidth.help: Width of each side's lithophane. The lamp gets wider with more sides: the info box shows the size across.
shape.polygon.param.lidMagnets.help: One small disc magnet in the top of each corner post and one in the lid above it, so the lid clicks into place.
info.polygon: {n} sides, lithophanes {w} × {h} mm, {t} mm thick; {f} mm across the flats, {c} mm across the corners
shape.box.param.picFormat.help: Your photo's proportions. Width and height then stay in this format, measured on the visible picture inside the margin, so a photo of that format fits without cropping. The link button switches this off, or on again with the current proportions.
ui.formatLink: Link width and height (keeps the current proportions)
shape.shade.name: Lampshade
shape.shade.param.topDiameter.help: Outside diameter of the shade's top edge. For a cylinder it is the diameter all the way down.
shape.shade.param.bottomDiameter.help: Outside diameter of the bottom edge. The picture is squeezed sideways towards the narrower end.
shape.shade.param.mount.help: Hanging: the socket clamps a spider ring, and the shade hangs on it by a narrow rim at its top edge. Standing: the shade's bottom edge sits in a groove in a round base with the lamp. On a lamp foot: the socket of a table lamp clamps a separate spider, whose spokes reach the shade's bottom or top edge.
shape.shade.param.tableLamp.help: With a socket the base is a hollow drum: the socket goes in from below and is screwed tight with its shade ring on top.
shape.shade.param.socket.help: The lamp socket this is made for: E27 (the standard large thread) or E14 (the small one). It sets the size of the socket hole.
shape.shade.param.spider.help: The spider is the ring with spokes that the socket clamps. Separate, it is pushed into the shade from below until it sits under the top rim. Joined, it prints with the shade, upside down, spokes on the bed.
shape.shade.param.spiderEdge.help: Where the spider's spokes meet the shade. Bottom: the shade stands on the spider's outer ring. Top: it hangs on the ring by a narrow rim at its top edge.
shape.shade.param.ringHeight: Socket ring height above the bottom edge
shape.shade.param.ringHeight.help: How far the shade reaches down past the socket: the plate the socket's shade ring clamps is this high above the shade's bottom edge. Low values hide the socket and the top of the foot.
warn.ringTooHigh: The socket ring is too high: the bulb would reach out of the shade. Keep it at {max} mm or lower.
warn.plateNoFit: At the socket ring's height the shade is too narrow for the spider's plate. Lower the socket ring or use E14.
info.spiderSupports: The spider's spokes are flatter than 45°: print the spider with supports. They only touch the spider, not the lithophane.
shape.shade.param.spokes.help: How many spokes hold the ring that the lamp socket clamps onto.
shape.shade.param.socketHoleE27.help: Fits the thread for the shade ring on the socket (usually 40 mm). Measure yours if it differs.
shape.shade.param.socketHoleE14.help: Fits the thread for the shade ring on the socket (usually 28 mm). Measure yours if it differs.
shape.shade.param.socketRoom.help: Height of the hollow under the base's top plate, for the socket's body. Most E27 sockets need about 45 mm.
shape.shade.param.baseRim.help: How far the base reaches out past the shade's bottom edge. Wider stands more firmly.
info.shade: Shade: Ø {top} mm at the top, Ø {bottom} mm at the bottom, {h} mm high, {t} mm thick; the picture runs {w} mm round
info.shadeHeat: Only LED bulbs, at most about 10 W: PLA softens from about 55 °C.
warn.shadeSteep: The wall leans out {deg}° on the way up as it prints. Above 45° it needs supports: make the two diameters closer or the shade taller.
warn.shadeThick: The wall is too thick for the narrow end of the shade, so it was thinned to {max} mm. Make the narrow end wider or the shade taller to keep the full thickness.
warn.spiderNoFit: The top is too narrow for the spider ring round this socket. Make the top diameter larger or use E14.
shape.sphere.name: Ball lamp
shape.sphere.param.sphereHeight.help: How tall the ball is after it is cut flat at the bottom. The lower the cut, the smaller the opening there: the info box shows its size.
shape.sphere.param.bandBottom.help: Where the picture band starts, in degrees below (negative) or above the middle. Above and below the band the ball is plain and glows evenly.
shape.sphere.param.bandTop.help: Where the picture band ends, in degrees above the middle. Fine detail comes out best near the middle, where the wall stands upright.
shape.sphere.param.mount.standalone: On its own, over an existing lamp fitting
shape.sphere.param.mount.base: In a base with a lamp (globe on a base)
shape.sphere.param.mount.help: On its own, the ball stands on its cut rim over the socket of a lamp whose glass ball it replaces. In a base, the rim sits in a groove of a round base that holds the lamp.
shape.sphere.param.cableHole.help: A 15 mm hole low in the back of the ball, for the cable of the lamp fitting.
shape.sphere.param.tableLamp.help: With a socket the base is a hollow drum: the socket goes in from below and is screwed tight with its shade ring on top.
shape.sphere.param.socket.help: The lamp socket this is made for: E27 (the standard large thread) or E14 (the small one). It sets the size of the socket hole.
shape.sphere.param.socketHoleE27.help: Fits the thread for the shade ring on the socket (usually 40 mm). Measure yours if it differs.
shape.sphere.param.socketHoleE14.help: Fits the thread for the shade ring on the socket (usually 28 mm). Measure yours if it differs.
shape.sphere.param.socketRoom.help: Height of the hollow under the base's top plate, for the socket's body. Most E27 sockets need about 45 mm.
shape.sphere.param.baseRim.help: How far the base reaches out past the ball where it sits. Wider stands more firmly.
shape.sphere.preset.fado: FADO style, Ø 20 cm (E27 socket, on feet)
shape.sphere.param.baseFeet.help: Three small feet near the rim, as on an IKEA FADO: the base stands on them and the cable runs out underneath. Not with a battery tray, which sits under the base.
info.sphere: Ball: Ø {d} mm, {h} mm high, opening at the bottom Ø {o} mm; the picture is {w} mm wide round the middle
info.sphereDetail: Prints standing on its cut, without supports. Fine detail comes out best round the middle; towards the top and bottom the wall lies flatter.
warn.sphereCut: The height must leave the cut below the ball's middle: between {min} and {max} mm.
warn.sphereBand: The picture band is very narrow: move its start and end further apart.
shape.sphere.param.projection.conformal: Round the ball, true on the surface (for patterns and maps)
shape.sphere.param.projection.front: From the front (one picture, for faces)
shape.sphere.param.projection.band: Round the ball (for panoramas and group photos)
shape.sphere.param.projection.help: From the front: the photo sits on the front of the ball, as seen from there; best for portraits. Round the ball: the picture runs round the ball as far as you set; seen from the side at eye level faces keep their proportions, and the narrower the picture, the less the ball's curve bends them. True on the surface: shapes keep their proportions when you look straight at each spot, but seen from the side they look a little flatter.
shape.sphere.param.frontWidth.help: How much of the ball the picture from the front covers, as an angle seen from the ball's middle. Over about 120° its sides get very stretched on the ball.
info.sphereFront: Ball: Ø {d} mm, {h} mm high, opening at the bottom Ø {o} mm; the picture from the front is {w} × {ph} mm
shape.sphere.param.frontBlend.help: 0 %: seen from in front of the picture's middle it looks just like the photo; from the side its edges look stretched. 100 %: it looks natural from every side; seen straight from the front its edges look a little smaller. In between mixes the two.
shape.sphere.param.backPhoto.help: The back half of the ball gets its own photo, which reads the right way round from behind. The two pictures meet at the sides. Choose it in step 2 under "Back".
shape.sphere.param.wrapWidth.help: How far round the ball the picture runs, centred on the front. 360° for a panorama all the way round; for a normal photo about 120° to 180°, or it is enlarged so much that faces bend round the ball.
shape.ornament.name: Ornament
shape.ornament.param.ornamentSize.help: Width of the ornament across its outline (a star across its points).
shape.box.param.loop.help: A ring on top, in one piece with the picture, for a ribbon or a hook.
info.ornament: Lithophane: {w} × {h} mm, {t} mm thick; prints lying flat, picture side up
shape.heart.param.panelWidth.help: Outer width of the lithophane including its frame.
shape.heart.param.lighting.plain: The heart on its own (to hang)
shape.heart.param.lightDepth.help: Room between the picture and the back wall. More depth spreads the light more evenly over the picture.
shape.heart.param.wallThickness.help: Side walls, back wall and top of the hood. Thicker walls let less light through.
shape.heart.param.lighting.stand: Open stand with a puck light holder behind the picture
shape.heart.param.lighting.base: Base with the puck lying behind the heart
shape.heart.param.lampDistance.help: Gap between the back of the picture and the front of the lamp holder. More distance spreads the light more evenly but makes the stand deeper.
shape.heart.param.holderDepth.help: How deep the puck light sits in the holder's cup. About half the lamp's height holds it firmly.
shape.heart.name: Heart
shape.heart.param.heartFlat.help: How wide the heart's point is cut flat, so it stands in the foot's groove. 0 keeps the point (for hanging).
shape.panel.param.lighting.frame: Slim frame with an LED strip
shape.panel.param.frameDepth.help: How deep the frame is from front to back. Deeper spreads the strip's light more evenly over the picture.
shape.panel.param.frameRim.help: How wide the frame is round the picture.
shape.panel.param.stripWidth.help: Width of the groove the LED strip is glued into, round the inside of the back. Most strips are 8 or 10 mm wide.
shape.panel.param.frameKeyholes.help: Two keyholes in the back plate, to hang the frame on two screws.
shape.panel.param.frameFoot.help: A separate foot with a groove the frame stands in.
info.frameStrip: LED strip: about {l} mm round the inside of the back; the cable leaves at the bottom
